name: The Weaponmaster Vindicator (Draven)
creator: sauronkaiser
description:
Important note: if this mod has visual bugs, try our autofixer (Available in the Runeforge official discord). If the bugs persist, please comment it to the author by DM or in the same discord so it can be put in the manual fixes list.

Base champion: Draven

Skin: Default

Author: Sauronkaiser

Description: The first of the three Vindicator brothers, inspired in Minecraft

Features:

-New model and textures.

-New full set of animations.

-New sounds.

-New particles.

-New Voiceover.

-New Splashart loading screen.

-New Ability icons and HUD.

-Two axes.

-Fan of Stephen king.

-Diggy hole enjoyer.

-Likes to scream sometimes.

Meet the other vindicator brothers!



-The Berserker vindicator (Darius):

[https://runeforge.dev/mods/fb3d8171-bd82-4758-b50a-433538509cda](https://runeforge.dev/mods/fb3d8171-bd82-4758-b50a-433538509cda)

-The Electric vindicator (olaf):

link to publish later



Lore:

The Weaponmaster vindicator was in the middle of a friendly competition with his twin brother to see who was better at throwing axes/tridents aganist a villager, when their older brother told them they had a new mission; repel an horde of wither skeletons comming from a nether portal somewhere in the overworld, as, somehow, a legendary beast known as The Wither had appeared and someone had to deal with his army.

Didn't take long to repel the horde to the portal they came from, and soon enough they performing an Omniman reference by entering the wither skeleton's dimension to slay all of them in their own territory.

However, while the skeletons army was being neutralized, there is still the problem of who will deal with The Wither itself and how.
